card.name: Nouns ending a drug-handling phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a short noun phrase in label instructions, such as 'solution', 'fluid', 'preparation', or the end of 'syringe' or 'dL'. It also fires on a comma after a product name or dose phrase.

modes.label: Formulation nouns
modes.description: Words like solution, fluid or preparation naming the liquid or product being handled or applied.
modes.example: directing the stream of<< solution>> toward the wall of the vial.

modes.label: Ends of units or device words
modes.description: The final piece of a measure or device word such as dL or syringe.

modes.label: Commas after a phrase
modes.description: A comma closing a product name or dose phrase.
modes.example: volume required per dose<<,>> NOT per day.
